/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from zipfile import ZipFile
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/user/Desktop/38_1.pptx')
with ZipFile(p) as z:
    for n in ['ppt/slides/slide3.xml','ppt/slides/slide4.xml','ppt/slides/slide5.xml']:
        data=z.read(n).decode('utf-8')
        print('\\n---', n, '---')
        # show shape names and text snippets roughly
        import re
        for i,m in enumerate(re.finditer(r'<p:sp>(.*?)</p:sp>', data),1):
            sp=m.group(1)
            name=re.search(r'<p:cNvPr["'^>]*name="([''^"]*)"'"', sp)
            texts=re.findall(r'<a:t>(.*?)</a:t>', sp)
            has_tx='<p:txBody>' in sp
            algns=re.findall(r'<a:pPr["'^>]*algn="([''^"]+)"'"', sp)
            print(i, name.group(1) if name else '?', 'tx', has_tx, 'text=', ' | '.join(texts)[:120], 'algns=', algns)
PY"

local_ctx=uno.getComponentContext(); resolver=local_ctx.ServiceManager.createInstanceWithContext('com.sun.star.bridge.UnoUrlResolver', local_ctx); ctx=resolver.resolve('uno:socket,host=localhost,port=2002;urp;StarOffice.ComponentContext'); desktop=ctx.ServiceManager.createInstanceWithContext('com.sun.star.frame.Desktop', ctx)
en=desktop.getComponents().createEnumeration(); doc=None
while en.hasMoreElements():
    c=en.nextElement()
    if c.supportsService('com.sun.star.presentation.PresentationDocument'): doc=c

def walk(container, prefix=''):
    for i in range(container.getCount()):
        sh=container.getByIndex(i)
        name=getattr(sh,'Name','?')
        st=getattr(sh,'ShapeType','?')
        txt=''
        try: txt=sh.getString()
        except Exception: pass
        if txt.strip():
            try: adj=sh.Text.createTextCursor().ParaAdjust
            except Exception as e: adj='?'
            print(prefix+str(i+1), name, st, 'adj', adj, 'text', repr(txt[:100]))
        # group supports XShapes getCount
        try:
            cnt=sh.getCount()
            if cnt:
                print(prefix+str(i+1), name, st, 'GROUP count', cnt)
                walk(sh, prefix+str(i+1)+'.')
        except Exception: pass
for slide_num in [3,4,5]:
    print('\\nslide', slide_num)
    walk(doc.getDrawPages().getByIndex(slide_num-1))

        name=getattr(sh,'Name','?')
        st=getattr(sh,'ShapeType','?')
        txt=''

            cnt=sh.getCount()
